context: I’ve just returned from China. They were celebrating the Chinese New Year there. Lots of people were dressed like dragons
questions: What are the most popular holidays in Russia? What is your favourite holiday and why? How do you celebrate it?
ideas: популярные праздники: Новый год, 8 Марта, 9 Мая
model:
Dear Ben,

Thanks for your letter! It was great to hear from you.

You asked about the most popular holidays in Russia. The biggest ones are New Year, Victory Day on the ninth of May and Women's Day on the eighth of March. Everyone loves them.

My favourite holiday is definitely New Year. I adore the winter atmosphere, the sparkling lights, the presents and the feeling that something magical is about to happen.

We celebrate it with the whole family. We decorate the tree, cook a huge dinner, watch films and wait for midnight to make our wishes and set off fireworks.

Write back soon!

Best wishes,
Dan

Dear Jane,

Thanks for your letter! It was great to hear from you.

You asked how I help my parents around the house. I usually wash the dishes, tidy my room and take out the rubbish. Sometimes I also walk our dog in the evenings.

In our free time we love doing things together. We watch films, play board games and go for long walks in the park at weekends. Those moments are the best.

Best wishes,
Kate

Dear Jim,

Thanks for your letter! It was great to hear from you.

You asked how often I miss school because of health problems. Luckily, not very often, maybe two or three times a year, usually when I catch a bad cold in winter.

When I'm ill and have to stay indoors, I try not to get bored. I read books, watch my favourite series, draw and chat with friends online until I feel better.

To stay healthy, I do quite a lot. I go jogging, eat fruit and vegetables, drink plenty of water and try to get enough sleep every single night.

Write back soon!

Best wishes,
Sam

model:
Dear Andrew,

Thanks for your letter! It was great to hear from you.

You asked what I find most difficult in learning English. For me, it's definitely the tenses and irregular verbs. There are so many of them, and I often mix them up when I speak.

Outside the classroom I do many things to improve. I watch films in English, listen to songs, use learning apps and even chat with native speakers online.

In my opinion, the best way to learn a language is constant practice. You should use it every day, not be afraid of mistakes, and try to think in that language.

Do Russians often go hiking or camping? Yes, quite a lot, especially in summer. Many families love spending weekends in the forest, cooking over a fire and sleeping in tents.

If I could spend a summer anywhere in Russia, I'd choose Baikal. I'd love to see its crystal-clear water, breathe the fresh air and take amazing photos there.

Best wishes,
Kate

You asked which traditional Russian dishes I'd recommend. You should definitely try pelmeni, bliny with jam, and the famous Olivier salad. Pirozhki with different fillings are delicious too.
